intro.text: A listener who follows the spren Ulim with Venli.

items.text: Ulim chose Altoki, Venli, Demid, Melu, Mrun and five others to open themselves to new power during the Everstorm. They did not know they were offering their bodies to the Fused. All but Venli were taken or killed; Altoki was taken by a Fused that seemed predatory and deranged.
